title: Video Merger
summary: Easily select, arrange, trim, and join multiple video clips into a single file.
description:
Video Merger is a simple tool that helps you combine videos into one continuous file directly on your device. Whether you want to merge two videos, organize short recordings, or combine multiple videos into one, the app provides an easy workflow that keeps the editing process straightforward.

Choose your clips, arrange them in the order you want, make quick adjustments, and create a single video that you can watch or share from the built in creations gallery.

Merge Your Videos

Video Merger makes it easy to merge videos together without complicated editing tools. Select two or more clips from your gallery, review the order, and create one continuous video from your selected files.

Features include:

• Select multiple videos from your device.
• Merge multiple videos into one project.
• Combine two videos or several clips in a single export.
• Join video files without unnecessary steps.
• Create a finished video using an easy video combiner.

Arrange Clips Your Way

The order of your videos matters. Before processing begins, you can drag and drop each clip into the sequence you prefer.

This makes it simple to organize travel recordings, family moments, event highlights, or any collection of clips before you combine video clips into one final video.

Trim Before You Merge

Each selected clip can be adjusted individually before it becomes part of the final video.

• Trim the beginning of a clip.
• Trim the ending of a clip.
• Keep only the sections you want.
• Use the app as a video trimmer and joiner for simple editing before merging.

If you only need certain moments from each recording, trimming helps prepare your videos before they are joined together.

Adjust Audio Volume

Some recordings may have lower audio than others. During the merging process you can increase the volume of your selected clips to make quieter recordings easier to hear in the finished video.

Handle Different Video Files

The app is designed to combine videos into one even when your selected clips have different audio states. It can merge files where some videos contain sound while others do not, helping create a continuous result with fewer interruptions.

For compatible video files, the app can also combine mp4 files as part of the normal merging process.

Creations Gallery

Every completed project is saved inside the built in gallery.

From one place you can:

• Watch merged videos.
• Share completed videos.
• Access your previous creations whenever you need them.

Simple Editing Experience

The interface focuses on the essential tools needed for everyday editing. Whether you need a video joiner for camera recordings or a video cutter and joiner for preparing clips before combining them, the process is easy to follow from start to finish.

Many people wonder how to merge videos together, how to combine videos, or how to join two videos together. This app provides the tools to complete those tasks directly on your device. It also helps when you need to combine videos android, merge videos android, merge videos without watermark, or combine multiple videos into one using a simple editing workflow.
